split each sanskrit word at its sandhi and compound junctions into its component words in unjoined devanagari, separated by ' + '. answer with the split only.

purushashcha => purushah + cha
padavishtitvabhavaditichenna => chet + na
punastatrotthaya => punah + tatra + utthaya
yavadasy => yavat + asya
dhanamapi => dhanam + api
